privacy.tenant_and_workload_ids: keyed HMAC pseudonyms in logs; never metric labels
privacy.secrets: any field whose key matches (secret|token|password|passwd|key|mac|signature|credential) is redacted
privacy.request_payloads: logged only as digests in the audit ledger payload

export.forbidden: raw audit ledger outside the tenant's jurisdiction without legal review

retention_enforcement: host-side (log/metric backends); the audit ledger is rotated by the operator per ops/RUNBOOK.md#audit-rotation
